# hackerone_program (Data Source)

Looks up a HackerOne program by handle, exposing its numeric ID for use with write resources.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String) The program handle (as shown in the program URL).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric ID of the program.
- `organization_id` (String) Numeric ID of the organization that owns the program. Use this for the `organization_id` argument on `hackerone_asset` and `hackerone_asset_scope`.
- `policy` (String) Current program policy text.
